1: const fs = require('fs');
2: const path = require('path');
3: 
4: /**
5:  * Resolve a file path down to its real, canonical filesystem path.
6:  * Follows all symlinks and resolves `.` / `..` segments.
7:  * Works consistently across Node versions by using the native
8:  * OS-level realpath implementation (fs.realpathSync.native on
9:  * Node >= 10.6, falling back to fs.realpathSync).
10:  *
11:  * @param {string} filePath - The path to resolve.
12:  * @returns {string} The canonical filesystem path.
13:  */
14: function resolveSymlinks(filePath) {
15:   return fs.realpathSync.native(filePath);
16: }
17: 
18: /**
19:  * Async version: resolves a path using the callback-based fs.realpath,
20:  * available in all Node versions (no native-only dependency).
21:  *
22:  * @param {string} filePath - The path to resolve.
23:  * @returns {Promise<string>} The canonical filesystem path.
24:  */
25: async function resolveSymlinksAsync(filePath) {
26:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
27:     fs.realpath(filePath, (err, resolvedPath) => {
28:       if (err) return reject(err);
29:       resolve(resolvedPath);
30:     });
31:   });
32: }
